newsitem.title: USA: Enron to build 80 MW Guam power plant.
newsitem.headline: Enron to build 80 MW Guam power plant.

text.p: Enron Corp said on Monday it has signed an agreement with the Guam Power Authority to develop an 80 megawatt baseload power plant in Piti, Guam.
The $140 million diesel plant will be constructed, owned and operated by Enron Corp, the company said.
Under a build-operate-transfer (BOT) arrangement, the plant will be transferred to the Guam Power Authority, an agency of the Guam government, in 20 years, Enron said.
Under an agreement, the Guam Power Authority will provide the fuel and Enron will convert it to electricity, Enron said.
Project construction is expected to begin by July 1997, and the plant is expected to be in operation in December 1998, the company said.
The project is being developed in cooperation with Guam-based MCM Consultants Inc, an energy consulting firm.
